name: M7.ObjectiveComparison.pareto_comparisons
statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (a b : Fin m → ℤ) (i fuel : ℕ) (seen : Bool), (M7.ObjectiveComparison.paretoFrom a b i fuel seen).2 ≤ 2*fuel
guidance: Induct fuel generalizing i seen; charged branches cost0,1 or2+recursive. These count the actual comparisons in the definition; arithmetic via omega. Return tactic lines only, no leading by.
